typography.rationale: Jost is a precise, geometric sans-serif that closely matches Century Gothic. It provides the clean, round, web-safe geometric feel requested.

visual_enhancers.abstract_graphics: Use pure CSS/SVG patterns. For example: a subtle dot grid background (using radial-gradient), geometric diagonal cuts, or SVG network nodes using stroke-[#1B4C6B]/10. Do not use image files.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use 'lucide-react'. Apply primary color (#1B4C6B) with occasional accent touches (#E8743B). Use strokeWidth={1.5}.
visual_enhancers.animations: Use framer-motion for smooth entrance. Fade-in and slide-up for text blocks, staggered reveals for cards.

media.images: FORBIDDEN. No stock photos, no AI generated photos. Use CSS and SVG.

sections.content: Logo on left. Desktop Nav: Accueil, Services, Solutions, Formations, À propos, Contact. CTA 'Demander un devis' on right. Mobile hamburger.

Headline: 'Votre partenaire de confiance pour vos solutions IT'. Subtitle: 'Relais IT vous accompagne dans la transformation numérique avec expertise et sécurité.'. CTAs: 'Découvrir nos services' (Primary) & 'Demander un devis' (Outline). Background: Abstract tech SVG pattern (nodes/grid). Height: min-h-screen.
6 Cards Grid (Support, Consulting, Solutions, Training, Hardware, Assistance). Minimalist icons, clean hover effects.
7 items. Use a Bento grid or alternating staggered list layout. Strong typography, numeric markers (01, 02, etc.). Background: subtle grey (#F8FAFC).
6 Trust points. Icons, bold metric/title, short text. Emphasize security, expertise, support.
Training programs overview. Callout card styling.
Mission statement. Clean typography, large geometric accent shape.
Two columns: Contact Form (Nom, Email, Téléphone, Objet, Message + Submit Button) and Info Card (Phone: 07 47 73 25 57, Email: contact@relaisit.com, Location: Abidjan).

Background #1B4C6B. White logo placement (requires care as logo has white background; place it inside a white rounded box or use CSS mix-blend-mode if appropriate, but keeping it in a white pill/container is safest). Quick links, services list, contact info, copyright.
Simple isolated route/view to list contact submissions. Basic table layout.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build as a React SPA with a single-page scrolling structure using standard section IDs (e.g., id='services').
Add the Google Font 'Jost' to index.html and configure Tailwind to use it as sans.
Strictly adhere to the NO IMAGES rule for content. Create visual interest exclusively through typography, white space, CSS shapes, and SVG patterns.
Use data-testid attributes on ALL interactive elements (buttons, nav links, form inputs) and key informational components.
Ensure all French text is grammatically correct and layout gracefully handles the string lengths.
For the Footer, since the logo has a white background, place the logo inside a white rounded container to make it look intentional on the dark navy footer background.
Create a mock simple admin view or component (e.g. /admin) that displays a list of contact form submissions using Shadcn/Tailwind tables.
